items: 1 pkg bacon, cut in pieces and cooked until crisp
2 bunches raw broccoli (flowers only), cut in bite-size pieces

steps.title: Combine the salad
steps.body: Place in bowl: **1 pkg bacon**, cut in pieces and cooked until crisp; **2 bunches raw broccoli** (flowers only), cut in bite-size pieces; **1 cup raisins**; **1 cup sunflower seeds**; and **1 small red onion**, chopped.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.body: Mix dressing: **1 cup mayonnaise**, **⅓ cup sugar** and **2 Tbsp red wine vinegar**.
